Answer: B
Reason: The image shows a broad, dense linear opacity extending vertically from the upper to lower right hemithorax that follows the course of a rib but appears distinct and posteriorly located, which is characteristic of an intrathoracic (supernumerary) rib. This congenital anomaly typically arises from the posterior aspect of a normal rib and projects into the thoracic cavity, matching the description in option B.
